id./param/scenario/cs/a_060_cs_010.pack|cs_: "Phew... Finally, a place with people. Doesn't look like anyone's chasing us, but what now...
"Well, well! You two look like travelers! You've come at a perfect time!
"You see, I just opened a steam bath in the back of the village...
"Right now it's free for the first hundred guests! You'd be foolish to miss this chance!
"Sorry, pal, but we've got no time for baths. Take your sales pitch somewhere else.
"Oh no, sir! A bath is a must, whatever the situation. Otherwise people will take you for suspicious characters.
"Well... we might smell a bit. Who knows when we'll see another bath. Maybe we should take one while we can...
"Hey, {var:1}. Since we've got the chance, let's wash off the sweat. I'm going ahead.
"Right! One guest, this way! Right this way, please! Watch your step!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_060_cs_020.pack|cs_: "Be gentler with a lady! Rough men never get the girls!
"Ugh, quit squawking! Sorry, but I'm busy. No time to deal with kids.
"What? Talking to the bartender is fine, isn't it?! He might know where my sister went!
"This is no place for kids. For a lost child, there's a guard post at the village entrance. Go talk there.
"Hmph, fine! I thought the bartender would understand, but there's no helping such a stubborn head.
"Huh? You're...? May I ask your name?
"Sorry, the wind drowned it out. May I ask your name?
"I'd love to talk more, but I'm more worried about my missing sister now. I'll look around the village first.
"...To think I'd meet you in a place like this. Fate really is strange.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_060_cs_030.pack|cs_: "Hey, you're late, {var:1}. The steam bath here is pretty good.
"Looks like we're the only customers. Since we have the place to ourselves, let's take a breather.
"But what do we do from here? It's only a matter of time before our pursuers show up.
"...By the way, you looked around the village a bit, right? Notice anything?
"What's with that face? You're hiding something from me, aren't you? Come on, tell me.
"A girl looking for her sister? Yeah, I saw her too. Asking around a bar, how precocious.
"A sister... a sister, huh...
"Having a useless sister is rough on the older brother or sister...
"Hey...
"...Did you say something?
"Hey, where are you...?
"Hey. Could this be... a gho...
"Where are you...? Where did you go...?
"...Just a kid. Don't scare me like that. What are you doing here?
"I was... waiting at the inn...
"Daddy went to take a bath and never came back...
"Where did you go...? That's so mean... *sniff* *sniff*...
"Ah... a lost child.
"...Hey, {var:1}. The girl outside the bar looking for her sister... could she be this kid's sister?
"She must be so scared. Poor thing. Let's do something for her.
"Hey, little one. What's your name?
"*sniff* *sniff*... I... I'm Connie...
"All right, Connie. We'll take you to your family, so follow us.
"R-really? Thank you...
id./param/scenario/cs/a_060_cs_040.pack|cs_: "...Oh, there she is. Still bossing adults around.
"Honestly, they won't listen at all. Everyone in this village is so stubborn...
"Hey, kid. We found the sister you were looking for.
"There, she's your sister, right? Don't hide over there, come on out.
"I'm an only child. The one who went missing is my daddy.
"Honestly, you don't even listen. What a greenhorn.
"What, you little... You're the kid here...
"Anyway, that girl seems lost too, and this is getting us nowhere.
"Hey, {var:1}, was it? Sorry, but would you take me to the bartender?
"Even if you say no, I'm coming along. I can't get into the bar myself, so you'll have to manage.
"Thank you. I can't enter the bar alone, but with you two there it should work out.
"I'm Veronica. I'll come along with this girl, so I'm counting on you.
"You must have been scared, tossed around by these unreliable big brothers. It's all right now.
"Geez, kids these days are so cheeky... Let's drop them at the bar quick and hurry on.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_060_cs_050.pack|cs_: "Welcome, ...
"Oh, it's you! Coming back again?! A kid alone in a bar...
"...Is something wrong with our companion?
"Oh, no, my apologies. With adults along it's fine. Please take your time.
"Good day, Bartender. May I sit here?
"Ho ho, what a lively little lady. Will you have the bartender's Surprise Kelp Tea?
"Kind of you, but I've no time to relax now. We came looking for someone.
"I'll get straight to the point.
"Did a girl named Serena, dressed like me, come looking for someone?
"Serena... Serena, hmm...
"...Ah! That little lady came here looking for her sister, but when she found she wasn't here she left the village.
"...I see. Where did Serena say she was going?
"She said she felt her sister was somewhere west and would head there. A strange girl indeed...
"West? Oh no, we just missed each other! Serena is trying to rescue me...!
"Actually, while I was in the steam bath, monsters kidnapped me, and I was shut in their hideout until now.
"I finally escaped, and now my sister Serena is headed for the monsters' hideout...
"Hey... {var:1}. You're no ordinary travelers, are you? I can tell without asking.
"I can't explain it all yet, but please, don't ask. Help me look for my sister.
"...Turning down a lady's request? You're rather cold-hearted. Please, help me find my sister.
"Thank you, {var:1}. I knew you'd say that.
"Big sisters... you're leaving? Connie wants to go too!
"Kids are in danger, so no. I have a lead on your daddy. I'll bring him back, so be a good girl and wait.
"You're a kid too... Can you even keep up with us?
"Who do you think I am? I'm Veronica, the strongest mage from the holy land of Arboria.
"If anything, you should watch out you don't hold me back.
"Let's go, {var:1}. The monsters' hideout is a huge labyrinth underground, west of here.
"Serena must be in there too. The entrance should be near the west coast, so let's aim for that first.
"I know, you know. Who you are... Don't betray my expectations.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_060_cs_052.pack|cs_: "Phew, close one. There's a pit trap ahead, as I recall.
"The one who built the trap can't go blundering into his own hole. I'll take a detour here.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_060_cs_058.pack|cs_: "Oops. You need a password to pass here. Let's see... oh yeah!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_060_cs_060.pack|cs_: "Huh. A spring in a place like this.
"Oh! That's...!
"Serena... Serena! Hold on, pull yourself together!
"...Serena? She's your sister?
"You promised we'd always be together... Please answer me, Serena...
"Mm... hmm...
"Pardon me, I was looking for someone... I must have gotten tired and fallen asleep by the spring...
"...S-sister?! What a pitiful state you're in...
"Huh? Y-you... you can tell it's me?!
"Hee hee, I've been your sister for years. I won't mistake you just because you look a bit different.
"Geez! Don't collapse in such a confusing way! I thought you'd...
"Sorry to interrupt, but Serena is your sister, right? What's going on?
"Truth is, she and I are twins.
"There's a deep reason I look like this.
"The monster that kidnapped me used this place as a hideout, snatching many people and draining their magic.
"I held out so they wouldn't drain it all, and it seems they drained my age too. That's why I look like this.
"So don't be fooled. I'm a full-grown lady. From now on, don't treat me like a kid!
"Fine, I get it. But in that state, can you really go on?
"No. That's why you'll help me until I take my magic back from that monster.
"I ask it of you too. I'll help everyone with healing magic. Now, let us go.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_060_cs_070.pack|cs_: "I warned you, and you still let the prey escape... Saying sorry won't cut it!
"That Veronica was no ordinary woman. Abnormal power, top-grade talent. A genius born once in many years.
"If I'd delivered all her magic, I could have become the right hand of the Dark One who will appear... And you, you idiots!
"No doubt, those monsters. They're the ones who kidnapped me from the steam bath in Hotto and dragged me here.
"See that big jar by the dragon? My stolen magic must be packed in there.
"I see, your magic is in that jar. Now what do we do...
"Wh-what are you?! Barging into the hideout of Jarvis!
"...Ha, I see. You came to deliver the prey I let slip. How kind.
"Good things come to those who rage! All right, boys, time to work! Drain their magic dry!
"No choice but to fight! Stay sharp, {var:1}!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_060_cs_090.pack|cs_: "Ugh... Is my dream of becoming the Dark One's right hand to end here...
"Hey, who is this Dark One? You mentioned it earlier too.
"Heh heh... Whatever I tell you, you'll be killed by the Dark One anyway... *cough*
"A Dark One who will appear someday...
"My magic seems to be sealed inside that jar.
"I hope this gets it back...
"Oh no... You haven't changed at all, sister... Your magic didn't return...
"Don't worry, I'm completely back to normal. I can feel magic filling me from the top of my head to my toes!
"But sister, that form...?
"Hmm... Looks like my age didn't go back.
"Well, I got younger, so it's fine.
"Oh my, how like you, sister. Somehow, I find this you endearing too.
"By the way, sister... did you notice about {var:1}?
"Of course, Serena. You noticed too. That's my sister for you.
"Luminary, chosen by Yggdrasil. We have waited for the day we could meet you.
"We are of holy Arboria's clan, born to protect the Luminary. From now on, we will guard you with our lives.
"{var:1}... You are no Darkspawn who brings calamity.
"The villagers told us the Luminary we sisters seek has a warm light deep in his eyes.
"...Well, I knew everything from the first time I saw you.
"Arboria's clan, protectors of the Luminary... As I guessed, you really are the Luminary who'll save the world.
"I have so much more to tell you, but first, please indulge me a little longer.
"There's one more person I want to save. There should be a room only reachable from here. Help me find it.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_060_cs_100.pack|cs_: "My, nothing but cells everywhere. It's rather ominous.
"It's all right now, mister. We took care of that nasty dragon.
"Ah, thank goodness... I was nearly dinner for those monsters.
"Honestly, you shouldn't leave such a sweet daughter alone and get caught by monsters in a place like this.
"What? You two... do you know that girl, Connie?!
"Don't worry. She's staying at the bar in Hotto. When you get back, thank the bartender.
"Thank you... My name's Noah. I'll never forget what you did.
"Noah...? I feel like I've heard that name somewhere...
"W-well, I'm worried about Connie, so I'll go ahead. Thanks again, really!
"Something nags at me, but never mind. Let's go back to Hotto and rest a while.
Leaving the wasteland labyrinth, {var:1} and company returned to Hotto and rested at the inn.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_060_cs_110.pack|cs_: "Hey, {var:1}. You're up. We just gathered too.
"At last the time has come. About you, the Luminary, and our sisters' mission...
"When the evil god descends from the heavens, the Tree's child bearing the crest of light shall appear. Our homeland's myth.
"Hard to believe, but you're the reborn Luminary who once beat the evil god with that crest and saved the world.
"The evil god was defeated, so why was a Luminary born into this world? Even we don't know.
"So to find the truth, we were chosen as envoys to lead you to Yggdrasil, closely tied to the Luminary.
"Hmm, Yggdrasil. If we go there, all the mysteries will be solved? Then let's go right away.
"You really never think. Yggdrasil floats in the sky. Do you think it's easy to reach?
"The Luminary who fought the evil god crossed the sky to the tree, but time buried those records.
"What's that? You mean even you two don't know?
"Yggdrasil, huh... Hm? Wait. We might learn something.
"Yeah. That guy we saved yesterday is actually a famous informant. He might know something about Yggdrasil.
"He said he'd go back to the bar to fetch his lost daughter. Let's go to the bar for now.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_060_cs_120.pack|cs_: "Daddy... let's go home. We're bothering the bar staff.
"Just one more drink, it's fine. A drink after a close call tastes the best...
"I remembered you, mister. You're Noah, the informant who's pretty famous in the underworld, right?
"They say you turn your bad luck to advantage, get tangled in trouble, then sell it as news. Am I wrong?
"Heh, well, you got me. Yes, walk down a road and the scoops come to me. Noah the genius informant, that's me.
"When they took me, the bath curtains had been swapped, and I wandered into the women's bath by mistake.
"My luck didn't last. There I saw a woman fighting desperately against the kidnapper monster.
"I meant to help, but I was unarmed and got caught right along with her. You know the rest.
"By the way, mister, do you know Yggdrasil? Any info tied to it will do. Tell us what you know.
"Oh... Yggdrasil, a big target. Very well. You saved my life, so I'll tell you my best scoop.
"Before Hotto, Connie and I got heatstroke in the southwest desert. Just when we thought we were done for!
"Soldiers of the desert kingdom Gallopolis luckily passed by and carried us to the castle and nursed us.
"When I came to, I saw it! A branch glittering in seven colors, displayed inside the castle!
"My eyes don't lie. That has to be Yggdrasil... a branch of it, I'd say.
"Oh my, sister, a branch of Yggdrasil glittering in seven colors in the castle?! It's worth a visit!
"Right. A branch, but still Yggdrasil. If it keeps shining, it'll surely guide the Luminary!
"You can be useful sometimes. I'm a little impressed.
"Then sister, let's head to Gallopolis first.
"Go through the southwest checkpoint and we should reach the kingdom of Gallopolis.
"{var:1}, the journey ahead will be long, but please take care of us sisters.
Veronica and Serena joined the party!
"...And here, this. Since you're going to Gallopolis, I'll leave it with you.
{var:1} obtained the Hotto pass!
"Gallopolis guards seal the southwest checkpoint tightly. Show them that pass and you should get through.
